**KANSAS CITY** (November 17, 2026) — AECOM, the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced it has been selected by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Kansas City District to provide architecture and engineering services in support of a broad range of civil works projects throughout the District’s area of responsibility.


Under the contract, AECOM will support projects that seek to mitigate flood risk, strengthen water infrastructure, restore ecosystems, and enhance the resilience of communities across the region. The firm’s multidisciplinary team will provide planning, design, environmental compliance, surveying, cost engineering and other services for initiatives spanning flood risk management, water supply, waterway navigation, ecosystem restoration, recreation and environmental infrastructure.


“The Kansas City District delivers critical civil works programs that strengthen flood resilience, maintain vital water resources infrastructure and restore ecosystems throughout the Missouri River Basin,” said Karl Jensen, executive vice president of AECOM’s National Governments business. “We are honored to continue our longstanding work with the District, bringing engineering expertise, integrated delivery capabilities, and strong regional presence to support the District’s key priorities while helping deliver resilient solutions for the communities it serves.”


AECOM will draw on extensive experience delivering flood risk management systems, dams, levees, pump stations, channels, and ecosystem restoration programs. The team will also leverage proprietary digital tools and proven cost engineering capabilities that will help streamline NEPA and environmental compliance processes, strengthen cost and schedule management, support risk-informed decision-making, and help accelerate project delivery while meeting federal requirements and budget constraints.


The award builds on AECOM’s more than 35-year relationship with the USACE Kansas City District, where the firm is currently providing[environmental remediation services](https://aecom.com/press-releases/aecom-selected-to-continue-providing-environmental-remediation-services-for-the-u-s-army-corps-of-engineers/) and supporting critical federal infrastructure priorities. AECOM has also partnered with USACE districts nationwide on some of the country’s most significant water resources and civil infrastructure programs.


**About AECOM**


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $15.1 billion in fiscal year 2026. Learn more at[aecom.com](https://aecom.com/) .
